permission.description: Allow raising the shell's main management window. Granted to both remote webviews (the harness workbench at http://127.0.0.1:<port> and the DeepSeek official chat at https://chat.deepseek.com) so the injected pull-string launcher can bring the panel to the foreground on either surface; tauri-build only exposes app commands to capabilities through an app-level permission file like desktop/src-tauri/permissions/app-commands.json, so an explicit allow-list is required for any remote webview to invoke the command.

Allow every app command from the shell's own local windows (the management panel). Defining ANY app-level permission flips Tauri from 'app commands are open to local windows' to 'app commands require an explicit grant', so this permission restores the pre-existing behavior for the local UI. Maintenance: every command added to `tauri::generate_handler!` in lib.rs must be listed here, or its invoke from the panel fails with 'not allowed. Command not found'.
